facts.en: Paid cinema front-of-house assistant at Fictional Lanternreel Cinema from 2023-04 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-04 至 2026-08 在虚构灯卷影院任有薪前厅助理。

facts.en: Completed a community arts administration diploma at Fictional Mallowframe College in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构锦葵帧学院完成社区艺术行政文凭课程。

facts.en: Scanned admission tickets and directed guests to the screen and seat printed on their booking.
facts.zh: 扫描入场票，并按预订票上印明的影厅及座位引导宾客。

facts.en: Checked the duty manager’s session board before answering questions about captions, access routes or start times.
facts.zh: 在回答字幕、通行路线或开场时间问题前，核对值班经理的场次板。

facts.en: Referred seat-change requests and accessibility arrangements to the duty manager rather than promising unconfirmed options.
facts.zh: 将换座请求及无障碍安排转交值班经理，而非承诺未确认的选项。

facts.en: Counted collected reusable glasses by screening and placed them in the collection bins specified by the shift lead.
facts.zh: 按场次清点收回的可重复使用眼镜，并放入班次负责人指定的收集箱。

facts.en: Logged auditorium issues and notified the duty manager; the projectionist handled playback faults.
facts.zh: 记录影厅问题并通知值班经理；播放故障由放映员处理。

facts.en: Helped update a welcome-board layout for a 2025-05 community film weekend.
facts.zh: 2025-05 协助为社区电影周末更新欢迎板版式。

facts.en: Personally checked screen numbers and printed arrow placement; the events lead supplied the programme order.
facts.zh: 个人核对影厅编号及印刷箭头位置；节目顺序由活动负责人提供。

facts.en: The event log lists 9 scheduled screenings, of which 1 was cancelled before ticket sales; attendance totals were not supplied.
facts.zh: 活动日志列出 9 场计划放映，其中 1 场在售票前取消；未提供出席总人数。

facts.en: The log does not confirm that every remaining scheduled screening took place.
facts.zh: 该日志未确认其余每场计划放映均已举行。

facts.en: Uses ticket scanning, a seating-chart viewer and printed session boards.
facts.zh: 使用验票扫描、座位图查看器及纸质场次板。

facts.en: Completed a non-award introduction to digital cinema playlists in 2026-01 using a classroom simulator.
facts.zh: 2026-01 使用课堂模拟器完成不授予资格的数字电影播放列表入门课程。

facts.en: For that course, ordered 5 fictional clips into a sample playlist; it was never used for a public screening.
facts.zh: 在该课程中，将 5 个虚构片段排序为示例播放列表；该列表从未用于公开放映。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Paperbeam Puppet Circle from 2021-03 to 2023-02.
facts.zh: 2021-03 至 2023-02 在虚构纸束木偶社做志愿者。

facts.en: For that group, painted lightweight scenery panels and helped collect feedback cards after informal shows.
facts.zh: 为该团体绘制轻质布景板，并在非正式表演后协助收集反馈卡。

facts.en: Co-made a personal 3-minute stop-motion film in 2024 with 2 friends.
facts.zh: 2024 年与 2 名朋友共同制作个人 3 分钟定格动画。

facts.en: Personally built paper sets and moved the models; a friend filmed and edited the sequence, and the other supplied sound effects.
facts.zh: 个人制作纸质布景并移动模型；一名朋友拍摄及剪辑，另一名提供音效。

facts.en: The film was shown at an informal club gathering, not a juried festival or paid cinema release.
facts.zh: 该影片在非正式社团聚会上放映，并非评审制电影节展映或付费影院发行。

facts.en: Enjoys collecting patterns for handmade ticket-stub envelopes.
facts.zh: 爱好收集用于手工票根信封的图案。

facts.en: Wrote shift handovers for unresolved guest questions and equipment items awaiting manager review.
facts.zh: 为未解决宾客问题及等待经理审核的设备物品撰写轮班交接。

facts.en: No independent operation of the cinema’s production playback system is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录独立操作影院实际放映系统的经历。
